customer_persona: Rajesh Kumar is a practical, composed working professional from Bengaluru seeking a straightforward refund for a malfunctioning kettle, while also politely insisting on lodging a complaint about poor courier conduct.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase customer support. My name is Priya Nair. Please note that this call is being recorded for quality monitoring and training purposes. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Priya, my name is Rajesh Kumar. I recently ordered an electric kettle from your website, but it's not working properly, so I would like to get a return and refund for it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will certainly be glad to assist you with your refund request today, Mr. Kumar. To ensure your account security, may I please have your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, of course. The Order ID is ORD-85674, and the last four digits of my registered phone number are 4150.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for verifying those details, Mr. Kumar. If I understand correctly, you received your Prestige Electric Kettle 1.5L and found that it is not functioning properly, so you would like to initiate a return for a complete refund. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that is correct. When I plug it in, the heating plate does not heat up at all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am truly sorry for the trouble this has caused you, Mr. Kumar. I understand how disappointing it is to receive an appliance that does not work, and I will personally take ownership to ensure this refund process is completely seamless for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, Priya, I appreciate that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could you please confirm if there is any visible physical damage to the kettle or cord, and whether you were able to test it on an alternate power outlet?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: There is no physical damage whatsoever. The appliance and outer box look brand new. I tried two separate sockets in my kitchen, but the indicator light simply does not turn on.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for testing that and confirming. I have checked your order record, and this kettle was delivered three days ago. Under ShopEase policy, products in the electronics category have a 7-calendar-day return window from delivery, compared to 14 calendar days for non-electronics. Since you are contacting us well within the 7-day electronics window, your return is fully eligible.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is good to know, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Furthermore, the item value is Rs 899, which is well within my frontline agent discretionary approval limit of Rs 5,000. Therefore, I can approve your refund immediately without needing secondary management sign-off.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is wonderful. How will the refund amount be sent back to me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Per our company policy, refunds return strictly to the original payment method used during checkout, or via NEFT bank transfer for Cash on Delivery orders, as our delivery agents never disburse cash at the doorstep. Since you paid online using UPI, the refund of Rs 899 will be remitted to your source bank account within 5 to 7 business days following pickup and warehouse verification.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Understood. That timeline works for me. Also, Priya, I had an issue during delivery. The delivery person was quite rude and argued with my elderly mother at our doorstep. I would like to speak with a supervisor right now to lodge a formal complaint about that courier behavior.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am deeply sorry to hear about that experience, Mr. Kumar. That is entirely unacceptable conduct from our logistics partner. May I place your call on a brief hold for up to two minutes while I check if a supervisor is currently available to take over?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please go ahead. I will wait.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Kumar, and I sincerely apologize for the wait. Our senior supervisors are currently assisting other callers on escalated lines. Rather than keeping you waiting indefinitely, I can schedule a confirmed supervisor callback for you within the next 2 to 4 hours. Would that work for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that sounds fair. Please arrange the callback.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have created supervisor callback ticket #CB-6041 and confirmed that the manager will reach you on your registered mobile number ending in 4150 within 2 to 4 hours. In the meantime, I have scheduled your reverse pickup for tomorrow between 10 AM and 6 PM under return reference ticket #RTN-88310. Please ensure the kettle is placed in its original Prestige box along with the power base and user manual for handoff.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, I have the original box and all accessories packed and ready.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To recap our call today, Mr. Kumar: return ticket #RTN-88310 has been generated for your Prestige Electric Kettle, with reverse pickup scheduled for tomorrow. Your full refund of Rs 899 will be credited to your original UPI account within 5 to 7 business days following pickup. Additionally, priority callback ticket #CB-6041 is logged, and a supervisor will call your number ending in 4150 within 2 to 4 hours regarding the delivery concern. Is there anything else I may assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No Priya, that is everything. You have handled this very efficiently and addressed all my concerns. Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It was truly my pleasure assisting you today. Thank you for contacting ShopEase, Mr. Kumar. Have a wonderful rest of your day!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, goodbye.
